hero.greeting: Hi 👋, I'm Abu Huraira. I help startups and businesses build web apps and AI solutions from Lahore, Pakistan.
hero.subtitle: I build modern web apps and AI solutions. I specialize in SaaS platforms, AI applications, Office.js add-ins, Chrome extensions, and business systems with a focus on clean architecture and great user experience.

about.heading: About Me
about.bio: I'm Abu Huraira, a Full-Stack and AI Developer based in Lahore, Pakistan. Since 2022, I've been building modern SaaS platforms, AI applications, Office.js add-ins, Chrome extensions, and business systems using React, Next.js, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, Python, and cloud technologies. I enjoy turning ideas into production-ready products with clean architecture, fast performance, and intuitive user experiences. My experience spans SEO automation, FinTech, healthcare, education, and SMB software while working with startups, agencies, and international clients.

education.institution: Punjab University College of Information Technology (PUCIT)

projects.heading: Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of products and platforms I've built across SaaS, AI, FinTech, healthcare, and education.

items.title: Immerseo.io
items.description: An AI-driven SEO platform that automates keyword research, content generation, publishing, and indexing. Built full-stack features including OpenAI workflows, Stripe billing, CMS publishing, and scalable backend services.
items.overview: Immerseo.io is a production AI SEO SaaS platform designed to help businesses automate their entire content workflow — from keyword discovery to publishing and search indexing. I contributed across the full stack, building AI-powered content pipelines, subscription billing, CMS integrations, and backend services that scale with user growth.
highlights: AI-powered keyword research and content generation workflows
Stripe subscription billing and payment management
Automated CMS publishing and search indexing
Scalable backend with Redis caching and job queues

items.title: ClikDone / Menutize
items.description: Website builder platform for SMBs with payments, referrals, ERP modules, and custom domains. Worked on Ruby on Rails backend, React frontend, Stripe Connect, and infrastructure migration.
items.overview: Menutize (formerly ClikDone) is a no-code website builder for small and medium businesses. The platform includes drag-and-drop site building, Stripe Connect payments, referral programs, ERP modules, and custom domain support. I worked on the Ruby on Rails API, React dashboard, payment flows, and cloud infrastructure migration.
highlights: No-code website builder with drag-and-drop editor
Stripe Connect for multi-vendor payments
Referral system and ERP module integrations
Docker-based infrastructure migration

items.title: AlphaScript
items.description: Investment banking platform with Excel and PowerPoint add-ins that automate financial reports, charts, and presentations using Office.js, Redis, RabbitMQ, Airflow, and Node.js.
items.overview: AlphaScript is an enterprise FinTech platform built for investment banking teams. It includes Excel and PowerPoint add-ins that automate financial report generation, chart creation, and presentation building. The system integrates Office.js on the frontend with a robust Node.js backend, message queues, and workflow orchestration via Airflow.
highlights: Excel & PowerPoint add-ins with Office.js
Automated financial report and chart generation
RabbitMQ message queuing for async processing
Airflow-powered workflow orchestration

items.title: PharmaKhata
items.description: Web and mobile solution for pharmaceutical order management, inventory, invoicing, and field sales. Includes Excel exports and real-time synchronization.
items.overview: PharmaKhata is a healthcare management platform for pharmaceutical distributors. It covers order management, inventory tracking, invoicing, field sales coordination, and real-time sync between web and mobile apps. Built for teams that need reliable offline-capable workflows and Excel-based reporting.
highlights: Cross-platform web and mobile order management
Real-time inventory and invoice synchronization
Field sales tracking and reporting
Excel export for accounting workflows

items.title: DevLearn
items.description: A MERN-based eLearning platform featuring authentication, dashboards, course management, and an engaging learning experience.
items.overview: DevLearn is a full-featured eLearning platform built with the MERN stack. Students can browse courses, track progress, and learn through structured modules. Instructors manage content through dedicated dashboards with authentication, role-based access, and course analytics.
highlights: JWT authentication with role-based access
Course creation and module management
Student progress tracking dashboards
Responsive UI for desktop and mobile

items.title: Kurkey
items.description: Bilingual landing page with a multi-step waitlist system, RTL support, backend integration, and conversion-focused design.
items.overview: Kurkey is a conversion-optimized bilingual landing page with full RTL (right-to-left) support for Arabic audiences. Features a multi-step waitlist funnel, backend API integration for lead capture, and a polished responsive design focused on maximizing sign-ups.
highlights: Bilingual UI with full RTL layout support
Multi-step waitlist signup funnel
Backend API integration for lead capture
Conversion-focused responsive design

items.title: MacOS Portfolio
items.description: Interactive MacOS-inspired developer portfolio built with Next.js featuring desktop-style navigation, animated windows, and responsive layouts.
items.overview: An interactive developer portfolio that mimics the macOS desktop experience. Users navigate through draggable windows, a dock, and animated transitions — all built with Next.js. The project showcases creative front-end skills with a unique, memorable user experience.
highlights: macOS-inspired desktop UI with draggable windows
Animated dock and window management
Fully responsive across all screen sizes
Built with Next.js and SCSS modules

items.title: Chrome Extensions
items.description: Built multiple Chrome extensions for productivity automation using Manifest V3, background workers, API integrations, and DOM manipulation.
items.overview: A collection of Chrome extensions built with Manifest V3 for productivity and workflow automation. Each extension uses service workers, content scripts, and Chrome APIs to integrate seamlessly with the browser and third-party services.
highlights: Manifest V3 architecture with service workers
Background sync and API integrations
DOM manipulation and content script injection
Chrome Web Store published extensions
